messages:
Marie: Heads-up: aiming to cut the next release next Fri. Proposed bumps: api -> 1.10.0, runtime -> 3.5.0, console -> 2.2.0, python-sdk -> 0.15.0. Can teams confirm compatibility + changelog entries by Wed EOD UTC?

AJ: On it. Rebasing the SDK branches now. Will update pyproject and add a short migration note for the streaming client rename.

Diego: Runtime FYI: PR #910 adds a memory-optimizer patch that looks promising but CI is tripping a kernel-mmap test. If it lands before cutoff we need a rebuild and ops coord for canary.

Marie: Cutoff reminder: Fri 18:00 UTC. After that only hotfixes with eng lead sign-off. No feature merges without a dev lead ok.

Ryan: @Diego any ETA on #910? Would like to plan canary windows.

Diego: Give me ~2h to reproduce and quarantine the flaky test. If I can't get a clean run, we'll omit the optimizer and do a follow-up patch.

Sophia: Console is green on my side. Draft changelog: https://git.internal/release/console/2.2/changelog.md — includes a note about dashboard RBAC changes and a small copy tweak.

AJ: SDK PRs: https://git.internal/sdk/python/pulls/1302  rebasing, pinging reviewers. Will include migration snippet in the changelog.

Marie: Also update the monorepo manifest at infra/releases/versions.json (so CI bumpers pick it up). Example manifest to keep everyone aligned:

```
{
  "api": "1.10.0",
  "runtime": "3.5.0",
  "console": "2.2.0",
  "python-sdk": "0.15.0"
}
```

ci-bot: build-bot: runtime image build queued for v3.5.0-rc1.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runtime:v3.5.0-rc1 image built (sha: def456) — canary tag ready.

Ryan: Proposal for canary rollout: 10% for 1h, 50% for 2h, then full. If we see regressions, route to runtime:3.4.x and roll back globally. Ops can standby for windows.

Diego: +1. We have fallback routing to runtime:3.4.x for 48h so rollback should be straightforward.

Marie: Action list (quick):
- Diego -> stabilize or mark skip for #910 (post status here)
- AJ -> finish SDK PRs, bump pyproject, add migration snippet
- Sophia -> attach console changelog note to release PR
- Ryan -> draft rollback/runbook and coordinate ops for canary
Ping me when done so I can open combined release PRs.

AJ: Merged SDK PR and pushed pyproject bump at 1760183000. Migration blurb added to changelog.

Diego: Flaky test quarantined and fix merged at 1760183600. Runtime CI is green now.

Marie: Final cut is Fri 1760210400 (Fri 18:00 UTC). After that only hotfixes with lead approval. I'll open the release PRs and tag maintainers.

Sophia: Added console note to the release PRs.

Ryan: Rollback doc uploaded: https://wiki.internal/releases/runtime-rollback.md. Ops confirmed schedule and will monitor canary windows.

Marie: Thanks team. I'll post a brief announcement in #announcements when tags are created.

ci-bot: notifier: release PRs created for api@1.10.0, runtime@3.5.0, console@2.2.0, python-sdk@0.15.0.
